instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of a couple on a snowy wooden bridge. On the left, the man in the black parka (R1) points to the right with his gloved hand, looking in that direction. On the right, the woman in the brown jacket (R2) holds his other hand and looks in the same direction with a bright smile. Soft, diffused daylight illuminates the cool winter forest background.
